d: The Quad has returned to the leaders’ level after more than two years. The leaders met in Manila for around 90 minutes and announced initiatives covering business, critical minerals, maritime surveillance, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity and counterterrorism. Mumbai will host the inaugural Quad Business Leaders’ Forum in 2027, while the four countries also plan their first maritime patrol aircraft exercise in a Quad context. But the summit also highlighted the grouping’s continuing challenges. The joint statement opposed attempts to change the status quo through force or coercion…
